title: harness
description: A project's harness.json (Implementation Decisions 1): the pin, autonomy, radius, the fallback consent, the ladder consent, the environment, the plotting library, the chat's rung, the stopping rule, budgets, reservations, pacing, notify, dashboard, policy overrides, docs theme.

research_version.description: how research/ is kept (Implementation Decision 17): init writes the release's RESEARCH_VERSION; a project without the key is at 1

model_fallback.description: the fallback consent (Implementation Decisions 15): whether Fable work falls back to Opus while Fable's weekly window is spent; a project without the key behaves as ask

ladder_changes.description: the ladder consent (Implementation Decisions 16): whether an autonomous run may change the rung ladder (tiers or difficulty) on its own; a project without the key behaves as ask

environment.description: where the project's tools and packages live and its jobs run (Implementation Decision 17; ticket 83): the shared tools, one conda prefix at .wayline/env, a venv, or one Singularity image at .wayline/env.sif; set only by `wayline switch --environment` once the new one is built from the locks and checked, never by the decider; a project without the key behaves as shared

plotting.description: the plotting library (Implementation Decision 17; ticket 102): Python with matplotlib and seaborn, Altair, or R with ggplot2, applied at each result's next drawing; set only by `wayline switch --plotting` on the owner's word, never by the decider; a project without the key draws with matplotlib

chat.description: the chat's rung (Implementation Decision 17; ticket 114): the model and effort each message of the dashboard's chat runs on; a project without the key talks on opus high

human_only.description: the decision classes the decider never resolves (Implementation Decisions 4): goal and data always, plus the classes the owner added at intake

budgets.description: the run's limits, read by code (Implementation Decision 17; ticket 87): wallclock_hours counted from the end of setup, gpu_hours as each job's hours times the GPUs it held; spending one ends the run budget_spent; null is no limit

stop_when.description: the stopping rule (Implementation Decision 17; ticket 87): objectives (the default, no objective open), a list of objective ids (those closed), or frontier (no work left); a project without the key behaves as objectives

gpu.description: GPU indices kept for the owner; empty means none

processes.description: process names whose GPU memory and cores count as reserved

hermes_python.description: the interpreter that runs hermes_cli; null disables the Telegram channel

policy.description: overrides of policy.json keys, same shape

docs.description: the documentation site (Implementation Decisions 13): the theme and layout chosen once per project by `wayline docs init`, the package the site documents, and the project's own environment Sphinx runs in

theme.description: the Sphinx html_theme; docs/conf.py must name it

package.description: the package directory the site documents, relative to the project (src/toy)

layout.description: each part of the site as a directory relative to the project, under docs/

python.description: the interpreter of the project's own environment Sphinx is installed in; absent or null is research/.cache/docs/venv, which wayline docs env creates

owner_email.description: sent in the scout's User-Agent to the polite pools

paper_order.description: the setup's answer on the paper order under `autonomous` (Implementation Decision 17; ticket 120): whether the decider judges the order at the stopping rule's own ends, and the venue the order compiles for beside compilations/plain/; a project without the key judges it for no venue

venue.description: a slug of guidelines/, or null for no venue

code_repository.description: the code repository's record (Implementation Decision 17): what intake absorbed into code/, and the setup question's shape, remote, visibility, and license

shape.description: a package of the developed method and every model the work applies it to, or a reproducibility repository of scripts, helpers, and the environment alone

visibility.description: private until the owner's word makes it public, which is on the irreversible list

license.description: the SPDX id of the license the code repository carries

url.description: what code pushes code/'s split to

how.description: a new private repository; a new private one carrying a taken-over repository's history, never a fork; or the owner's own repository, taken over on their word

branch.description: the branch code pushes the split to: main for a repository wayline created, the default branch of the owner's own

confirmed_public.description: the owner's one confirmation that their own public repository may be taken over

upstream.description: the project's own clone intake absorbed into code/ with git subtree add

clone.description: where the clone is, its .git outside the project's tree

moved_from.description: where the owner put a clone that lay inside the project, before intake moved it under .clones/

commit.description: the commit absorbed (SHA-1, or SHA-256 in a repository of that format)

uncommitted.description: the project's commit carrying the clone's uncommitted changes, or null when it had none

license.description: the license the clone came with, or null without a license file
